vc_checking.summary: All three current manual witnesses are semantically proofable. Membership yields a first-occurrence decomposition of the complete sequence and a spatial split at the anchor. The entail witness distinguishes an empty suffix from a nonempty suffix and exposes exactly the sentinel or successor fields updated by C. The two return witnesses rebuild the circular DLL after inserting the independent node, respectively for nonempty and empty suffixes, and the pure first-occurrence transform matches the rebuilt sequence. Spatial separation supplies all required address-distinctness facts. No annotation/spec repair or case_lib helper is required.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Select and split at the anchor's first occurrence, characterize the suffix boundary, splice the independent new node between anchor and successor, and rejoin the complete circular DLL.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Entail performs segment split and suffix case analysis; both returns fold link cells, prepend anchor/inserted, join prefix and suffix, and close the DLL.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: No occurrence in the prefix makes the Fixpoint choose unequal branches before the anchor and the insertion branch at the anchor; empty/nonempty suffix fixes the boundary case.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All witnesses use one function, one first-occurrence cut, one two-node prepend/join family, and the same spatial distinctness argument. Three witnesses are below the limit of 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For entail_wit_1, derive the anchor's first-occurrence split from In, recursively split xizi_dllseg, prove the Fixpoint insertion equation across the no-anchor prefix, and destruct the suffix to expose either sentinel or old-successor fields. For return_wit_1, refold the nonempty successor cell, prepend anchor and inserted, join with the prefix, and close the DLL. For return_wit_2, use the same prepend/join route with the sentinel as successor and inserted as the last node. Derive address distinctness from separated field ownership using dup_store_ptr contradictions. Keep split/join helpers local to witness proof bodies; no case_lib helper is needed.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Use the complete-sequence first-occurrence decomposition as the bridge between the pure API transform and heap ownership. The inserted node is independently owned, then spliced between the selected anchor and its old successor; empty and nonempty suffixes differ only in whether that successor is the sentinel or a data node.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Same function, first-occurrence transform, segment split/join, two-node prepend, spatial distinctness family, no dependencies, and three witnesses within max_witnesses_per_group=12.
